title: Order-six quantum Latin square of cardinality 29
claim: There exists a real quantum Latin square of order 6 with cardinality 29.

historical_snapshot.source: Zhipeng Xu, New Cardinalities for Quantum Latin Squares of Order Six, arXiv:2607.11800v3
historical_snapshot.boundary: At that revision, cardinality 29 was the remaining unresolved order-six value.

current_parallel_result.source: Aishwarya P. Das and Durgesh Kumar, A Quantum Latin Square of Order Six with Cardinality 29, arXiv:2608.12607
current_parallel_result.boundary: This public paper also proves existence of a real QLS(6) of cardinality 29 and closes the order-six spectrum gap.
